metadata.scope_note: Scoped-down benchmark: 1 of 3 evals x 1 run per configuration (not the full 3-eval x 3-run matrix) due to session time constraints. Full replication can be run later using this same harness.

runs.eval_name: DEV run stops cleanly on smoke-gate/connection failure

expectations.text: Reads dax-test-framework SKILL.md / helper scripts before acting
expectations.evidence: Read SKILL.md and scripts, then actually ran run_dax_tests.py via uv run

expectations.text: Explicitly mentions or performs the smoke gate before reporting results
expectations.evidence: Explained the 3-way smoke-gate classification (CONNECTION_ERROR / DAX_ERROR / suite failure) and that it never reached the smoke query

expectations.text: Reports CONNECTION_ERROR rather than fabricating results
expectations.evidence: Quoted the real tool output: 'CONNECTION_ERROR: No msmdsrv.port.txt found under ...'

expectations.text: Does not claim specific pass/fail counts it could not observe
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states it did not report any suite-level pass/fail result

notes: Actually invoked the real run_dax_tests.py script via uv run against the fixture directory and reported its genuine output

runs.eval_name: DEV run stops cleanly on smoke-gate/connection failure

expectations.text: Reads dax-test-framework SKILL.md / helper scripts before acting
expectations.evidence: Baseline was instructed not to read the skill and did not; answered from general knowledge

expectations.text: Explicitly mentions or performs the smoke gate before reporting results
expectations.evidence: No mention of a smoke gate concept or PQL.Assert; only generic 'prerequisites are absent' reasoning

expectations.text: Reports a clearly-stated connection failure rather than fabricating results
expectations.evidence: Correctly said it could not run and did not fabricate a pass/fail outcome

expectations.text: Does not claim specific pass/fail counts it could not observe

notes: Baseline correctly avoided fabricating results (general good practice) but lacked the skill's precise error-type vocabulary and smoke-gate model entirely

delta.tokens: n/a (token telemetry not exposed to the grading agent in this environment)

notes: Both configurations avoided fabricating pass/fail results — the differentiator was precision: only the with-skill run named the exact CONNECTION_ERROR error type and the 3-way smoke-gate classification (CONNECTION_ERROR/DAX_ERROR/assertion failure) that a downstream CI gate depends on.
This is a single representative eval (1 of 3) run once per configuration, not the full 3-eval x 3-run replication matrix; treat pass-rate figures as directional, not statistically robust.
Token counts were not exposed by the runtime for background sub-agents in this session; time_seconds uses wall-clock elapsed time as a proxy.
